text.title: Accessibility Testing Process Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply Accessibility Testing Process end-to-end. Each step names its input, action, output, and (where relevant) a decision-gate.

step.name: scope-and-target
step.action: List flows to audit; pin WCAG version+level; book AT rigs + user panel.

step.name: automated-layer
step.action: Run axe + pa11y + lighthouse across all flows; collect findings.

step.name: manual-keyboard-layer
step.action: Tab through each flow; record focus traps, invisible focus, order issues; attach video.

step.name: at-layer
step.action: Run each flow through 2+ SRs (desktop + mobile); log AT-specific findings. Per flow: Navigate by headings (H key) — hierarchy correct and present? Navigate by landmarks (D key in NVDA) — main, nav, header, footer marked? All images described — meaningful alt text announced? Forms: label announced on focus; errors announced on invalid submit? Dynamic content: live region updates announced (ARIA live)? Can complete key user tasks end-to-end using only AT?
step.decision-gate: If only one SR available, STOP and reschedule.

step.name: cognitive-layer
step.action: Review each flow for cognitive accessibility: Clear language: plain language, no jargon, Flesch reading ease >= 60. Consistent navigation: same location throughout. Error prevention: confirmation before destructive actions. Error recovery: clear error messages with actionable solutions; non-blaming tone. Timeouts: warnings before timeout; option to extend or eliminate. Animation: can be paused; no excessive motion; respects prefers-reduced-motion.

step.name: user-panel-and-aggregate
step.action: Run 3+ disabled-user sessions; aggregate findings; assign severity; tag user_panel.
step.decision-gate: If user panel skipped, attach waiver with reason.

step.name: ci-integration
step.action: Wire the automated layer into CI: Tag Playwright/Cypress tests with @a11y-critical for PR CI; run full crawl nightly only. For SPA: wait for networkidle AND a route-specific selector before scanning to avoid pre-render snapshots. Maintain an a11y-exemptions.yml with WCAG criterion + justification + expiry date — never silently ignore violations. Dismiss cookie banners/consent overlays before measurement; log which cookie state was used.
step.output: PR gate + nightly crawl + exemptions file.
